sentences.en: People need to be more lively when presenting their work.
sentences.zh: 人们在展示工作时需要更加充满活力。

sentences.en: There isn't a place in this market that isn't lively.
sentences.zh: 在这个市场里没有一处不热闹的地方。

sentences.en: When really lively music starts playing, I start dancing unconsciously.
sentences.zh: 当真正充满趣味的音乐开始播放时，我会不由自主地跳舞。

senses.zh: 活泼的，活跃的；栩栩如生的
